explication: Flipper Zero Firmware is embedded firmware providing device applications and services. The principal storage workflow is: a user, host, or script initiates a file or SD-card operation; the storage API serializes it through the storage processor; the selected backend accesses the SD card; and status or data returns to the caller. Storage settings adds inspection, formatting, mounting, and benchmarking, while RPC, JavaScript, animations, and Bluetooth persistence reuse storage. The graph emphasizes sampled storage paths; unsampled internal-media implementation details are not expanded.
